description: This file defines the implementation of a 'greater than' predicate (GtPredicateImpl) as part of a query criteria system in the Eclipse Ditto project. It extends an abstract predicate and implements a method to accept a visitor for processing.

classes.name: GtPredicateImpl
classes.description: Implementation of a 'greater than' predicate used in query criteria, supporting visitor pattern and extending a base predicate class.

methods.name: GtPredicateImpl
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the predicate with a value to compare against.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a PredicateVisitor and invokes its visitGt method with the predicate's value.
